children: The unemployment rate in Costa Rica fell to 7.0% in the second quarter of 2026 from 7.4% in the same period a year earlier, but little changed from 7.1% in the previous quarter.
Nationwide, the number of unemployed people was estimated at 164,000, including 98,000 men and 66,000 women.
The unemployment rate was 6.8% for men and 7.2% for women.
The labor force stood at 2.35 million, comprising 1.43 million men and 921,000 women, while the net labor force participation rate was 54.6%, at 66.3% for men and 42.9% for women.
Employment rose to 2.18 million, with the employment rate at 50.8%, compared with 61.7% for men and 39.8% for women.
Informal employment totaled 785,000, including 438,000 self-employed workers and 348,000 wage earners or family helpers.

title: Costa Rica Unemployment Rate Falls to 7.0% in Q2
